title: China-Taiwan Tensions Escalate Over US Tank Delivery
description: China's Foreign Ministry dismissed Taiwan's Ministry of National Defense after US-delivered tanks arrived in Taiwan. Beijing criticized the US for military ties with Taipei, reiterating the one-China principle. Taiwanese officials rejected China's claims, affirming the existence of their Ministry of National Defense and commitment to democracy.

title: Strait Diplomacy: Dialogue over Discord
description: Taipei's mayor urged Chinese officials for peace and dialogue amid increasing military tensions around Taiwan. Addressing the Taipei-Shanghai Forum, Mayor Chiang advocated for reduced confrontations. Despite ongoing military activities by China, Chiang emphasized the need for continuous communication, while Shanghai seeks practical cooperation and tourism revival.

title: Taipei’s mayor calls for peace, less confrontation amid escalating tensions with China
description: China, which views democratically-governed Taiwan as its own territory, sends warplanes and warships near the island on an almost daily basis, and held a new round of mass military activities last week

title: FBI warns some lawmakers that China aims to create fake stories about them to erode support for Taiwan
description: The FBI has warned lawmakers in classified briefings that the Chinese Communist Party is crafting fake stories to portray them in a negative light because of their support for Taiwan.

title: Amid rising China-Taiwan tension, Beijing sends team to Taipei for pacts on healthcare, red panda
description: Deputy head of Shanghai's Taiwan Affairs Office Li Xiaodong and Shanghai Vice Mayor Hua Yuan arrived in Taipei on Monday for an annual forum hosted this year by the Taipei City government, which is led by the Beijing-friendly main opposition party Kuomintang

title: French Solidarity with Taiwan: A Resounding Endorsement for Self-Determination
description: An annual survey by the Descartes Foundation and the Institute of Advanced Studies in National Defence reveals strong French support for Taiwan's autonomy. The French public stands firm against China's claims, aligning with democratic values. The survey underscores a critical examination of global conflicts and information manipulation.

title: Why is US relocating thousands of Marines from Japan's Okinawa, a strategic island near Taiwan?
description: Okinawa's proximity to Taiwan— less than 700 kilometers (435 miles) away— makes it an important location for US military operations. It serves as a forward base for deterring potential threats, particularly from China

title: Is China setting the table for war? Washington must act with urgency
description: China is preparing for war, including a 2027 invasion of Taiwan.

title: China's Silent Strategy: Normalizing Military Presence Around Taiwan
description: China has introduced a new strategy involving discreet large-scale military drills around Taiwan, aimed at normalizing its military presence. This move has sparked tension, with concerns about China's intentions, especially following large naval deployments described as 'drills that dare not speak their name.'
